title: Financial Analysis Configuration Schemas
description: Formal JSON Schemas for configuring the Financial Analysis (FA) system, including Company Definitions and Account Mappings.

name.description: The human-readable name of the company.

ticker.description: The company's stock ticker symbol (optional but recommended).

DataSourceConfig.description: Configuration object for a single data source.

id.description: Unique identifier used to reference this source in AccountMappings.

config.description: Type-specific configuration parameters (e.g., file path for CSV, API key for Yahoo Finance).

PeriodConfig.description: Defines the time range and frequency for the financial analysis.

type.description: The period granularity (e.g., annual, quarterly, monthly).

start.description: The start period for the analysis (e.g., '2023', '2023-Q1', '2023-01').

end.description: The end period for the analysis (inclusive).

AccountMapping.description: Maps a financial account to either a source field or a calculation formula. Must include either 'sourceId'/'sourceField' OR 'formula'.

id.description: The unique programmatic identifier for the account (e.g., 'Revenue', 'COGS').

display.description: The human-readable display name for reports (e.g., 'Total Revenue').

sourceId.description: The ID of the data source configured in the 'dataSources' section from which to fetch this account's data. Required for source accounts.

sourceField.description: The specific field name within the data source to map to this account (e.g., 'Total Sales'). Required for source accounts.

formula.description: The arithmetic expression used to calculate this account. Required for calculated accounts. Formula must adhere to the grammar: supporting numbers, other ACCOUNT_NAME references, and operators +, -, *, /, and parentheses (). Future enhancements include period references (e.g., Revenue[t-1]) and functions.

oneOf.description: Source Account Definition: Must specify where to fetch the data.
Calculated Account Definition: Must specify the calculation formula.

company.description: Basic information about the company being analyzed.

dataSources.description: A list of data source configurations.

accountMappings.description: A list defining all source and calculated accounts.

periods.description: The time frame and frequency for the analysis.
